text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!!! Claiming the Osaka Hai 
crown is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Today confirmed it. Ever since I broke 
through that wall at the Kikuka Sho, I've 
been steadily growing—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Next up is the Tenno Sho (Spring). Just 
like the Kikuka Sho, it's a race tied 
deeply to both Sis and the Mejiro family.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I must prepare.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"What a powerful run, Dream Journey!! Keep 
this momentum going and take on the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"You were incredible today too!! Keep 
giving it your all!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (......Strange.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text:
“Dri-Jour is definitely my top pick for 
this year's Senior class! Her cool look 
and razor-sharp running style are just 
irresistible!!”

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text:
“Dream Journey is my absolute fave!! Her 
mysterious gaze is just so good...! And 
her racing outfit is super cool too, 
right?!”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Should I check it out?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, there is something I would 
like to ask you.
choice_data_list: What's with the formality all of a sudden?
What's wrong? You're being so formal.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that I have a respectable 
number of fans?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"At the recent Osaka Hai... in the paddock 
and after the race, I felt there were a 
lot of cheers from what seemed to be 
fans."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I've been cheered on before, but somehow 
the enthusiasm feels completely different—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I felt a bit out of place seeing more 
mentions of myself directly, rather than 
just voices calling me a follower of "Big 
Sis."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"And that is why I thought to check with 
you, Trainer-san."
choice_data_list: ...Um, are you teasing me by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I'm asking in all seriousness, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To think the day would come where I'd 
feel so dizzyingly overwhelmed by Dream 
Journey—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey had continually produced 
stellar results in many GⅠs, including the 
Classic Triple Crown, not to mention the 
recent Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many racing fans would surely vouch that 
she is an Umamusume running on the very 
front lines of the current era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with her fan base growing in 
proportion to her success, it should be an 
entirely natural progression—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And yet, I couldn't believe that someone 
as brilliant as her failed to realize 
that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...It seems that deep down, I 
subconsciously believed that I wouldn't 
gain any fans.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well... as you can see, I'm not exactly a 
flashy Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume like Vodka-san and Daiwa 
Scarlet-san have an aura and star quality 
equal to their physical prowess, and—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"As for my proud little sister, she was 
already cloaked in a transcendent 
brilliance even before her debut..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to such dazzling figures, isn't 
she truly plain as an Umamusume?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. So that wasn't the case after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I shall admit it frankly. As you say, I 
have many fans.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"And I realized... that until now, I had 
never truly paid proper attention to my 
fans."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
...Are you glad to see your fanbase 
growing?

...Are you glad to see your fanbase 
growing?

text_block_list.name: Big Sis's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhh!! Congrats on your second 
graded stakes wiiin!!!

text_block_list.name: Big Sis's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible runnnn!!! I'll be 
cheering for you in the next race, tooo!!

text_block_list.name: Big Sis's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah—— They're waving at us!! Wooohooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...You look happy, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
…………As her "journey" went on, Big Sis came 
to be loved by even more people.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And in response to that... Big Sis's smile 
after the race grew all the more joyful—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I just suddenly remembered that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember well the hoofprints left by 
Stay Gold, who steadily increased his fan 
base by running passionately for so long.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: History... I see, that too...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I have decided to rethink my approach a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I viewed the entire racing 
world where the "storm" moved simply as 
scenery on my "journey," but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I will try to perceive both myself and my 
fans as part of that scenery.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe through this... I can grasp 
something about that 'streak of gold.'"
choice_data_list:
Then why not try facing your fans 
directly?

Then why not try facing your fans 
directly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If becoming part of the scenery that her 
fans ought to see is part of Dream 
Journey's "journey," then I believe it is 
a necessary act.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What are fans to Dream Journey?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of presence Dream Journey is to 
the fans—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —To double-check, you mean.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...That's a very good idea.
choice_data_list:
The Fan Appreciation Festival is coming up 
soon, after all.

The Fan Appreciation Festival is coming up 
soon, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival is a massive event where 
Umamusume have plenty of chances to 
interact directly with their fans.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it does seem tailor-made.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then I think I shall face them a little. 
...My fans, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...How this plan will ultimately affect 
Dream Journey's future is completely 
unknown. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading into our next goal, the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), I had an intuition... that I 
might discover something that would change 
our "journey."
